name: Shortcode
description: Provides ShortCodes filter framework and API (like WP ShortCodes)
project_description: Shortcode provides a text-format filter framework and plugin API for WordPress-style [tag attr="value"]...[/tag] macros in Drupal. The base module ships no tags of its own; it defines the Shortcodes filter, a Shortcodes - HTML corrector filter for WYSIWYG formats, a 'shortcode' plugin type, and a ShortcodeService that parses and expands tags (with nesting, including a tag inside another instance of itself). New tags are provided by plugins in any module. Version 3.0.0 is a Drupal 12 coding-standards refactor: it adds PHP attribute-based plugin discovery (#[Shortcode]) alongside the still-supported annotations, introduces a MediaUrlResolver service and trait for media/file/image-style URL lookups, adopts constructor property promotion and container autowiring, and is a breaking release for third-party plugin developers (see UPGRADING.md). Install the shortcode_basic_tags submodule for a starter tag set (quote, img, highlight, button, dropcap, item, clear, link, block, random) or shortcode_example for a reference plugin. Requires Drupal core Filter; core_version_requirement ^11.1 || ^12.
